threat_model.primary_vector: MCP caller triggers mode=apply without any server-side check, causing arbitrary code execution via codex/claude subprocess
mitigations: structured audit log on every apply attempt

env_vars.AUTODEV_MCP_ALLOW_APPLY: Server-side permit gate; must be '1' to allow apply mode

caveats: Audit log not authenticated — writable by any local process at default path
Env var is process-level — no caller identity verification
No rate-limiting on repeated denied attempts
commit/push/tag defaults are advisory — plumbing to flow config not yet complete
verdict: PASS — primary RCE vector closed; dual-gate (param + env) enforced; audit trail present; full suite green
